description_en: This four-bayedPhalcā(four bays, that is, even numbers, are a rarity with this architectural type) is one of the fourphalcāslocated at the edge of the pond called Puncali Pukhū. No documented evidence is so far found to date its initial construction. The inscription from 1716 CE installed inside the Phalcā records its renovation and establishment of a statue of Bhavānīśaṅkara by Vaṃśīdharadeva Śarmā and his wife Lāvatī Brāhmaṇī, the descendants of its founder Jayasiṃhadeva. However, the Bhavānīśaṅkara statue mentioned in the inscription does not exist in or around the Phalcā at present. After the Phalcā was renovated, Vaṃśīdharadeva Śarma established aguṭhīto sponsor the celebration of its anniversary rituals, but no suchguṭhīexists anymore. According to local elders, a Brahmin clan living in Dūcva Ṭola used to distributesamaybajifrom the Phalcā during the Indrajātrā Festival until four decades back (c. 1980s CE).The Phalcā was completely dismantled and reconstructed in 2003 CE. During the reconstruction, it was moved few cubic feet back from its original location arguing that it narrowed the street. It was reconstructed again in 2019 CE with the financial support from the Lalitpur Metropolitan City Office after it was severely damaged during the 2015 earthquakes.
description_ne: पुन्चलि पुखू (पोखरी) को वरिपरि किनारामा चारवटा फल्चाहरू छन् । यो फल्चा ती चारमध्येको एक हो । चार कवलमा बनेको फल्चा पोखरीको पूर्वी किनारामा छ । प्राय फल्चा बिजोड कवलमा बनाइने परम्परा भएकोमा यो भने अपवाद स्वरूप जोड अर्थात् चार कवलमा बनेको छ ।यस फल्चाको प्रारम्भिक निर्माण मिति थाहा पाउन सकिने अभिलेख्य प्रमाण प्राप्त छैन । सन् १७१६ को एक अभिलेख फल्चाभित्र टाँसिएको छ जसमा जयसिंहदेवले बनाएको यो फल्चा उनकै वंशका वंशीधरदेव शर्मा र उनकी पत्नी लावती ब्राह्मणी दम्पत्तीले जीर्णोद्धार गरी भवानीशंकरको मूर्ति स्थापना गरेको चर्चा छ । यसबाट यहाँ सन् १७१६भन्दा अघिदेखि नै फल्चाको अस्तित्व भएको थाहा हुनआउछ । मूर्ति स्थापनाको चर्चा परे तापनि हाल फल्चा र फल्चा आसपास कुनै मूर्ति भएको देखिँदैन । वंशीधरदेवले जीर्णोद्धार पश्चात् यसको वार्षिक पूजाआजाको निम्ति स्रोत स्वरूप जग्गा पनि गुठी चढाएका थिए । तर हाल यो फल्चासंग सम्बन्धित कुनै गुठी अस्तित्वमा भएको देखिँदैन । स्थानीय बृद्धाहरूका अनुसार यस फल्चाबाट दक्षिणतिर पर्ने दूच्व टोलका एक ब्राह्मण खलकले करिब चार दशक अघिसम्म फल्चामा बसी इन्द्रजात्राको समय समय्बजि दान दिने गर्दथे । तर उक्त खलकले किन र कहिलेदेखि यो परम्परा छोड्यो भन्ने विषयमा स्थानीयहरूमा स्पष्ट उत्तर पाइँदैन ।जीर्ण हुँदै गएपछि सन् २००३ मा फल्चालाई पूर्णतः भत्काई पुनःनिर्माण गरिएको थियो । फल्चाले गर्दा बाटा साँघुरो भएको भन्दै यस पुनःनिर्माणको दौरान वास्तविक स्थानभन्दा फल्चा केही फीट पछाडि सारी पुनःनिर्माण गरिएको थियो । पुनःनिर्मित फल्चा पुनः सन् २०१५ को भूकम्पले क्षति भएपछि सन् २०१९ मा फेरि महानगरपालिकाले पुनःनिर्माण गरेको हो ।

historical_events.event_name: Renovation of the Phalcā, establishment of a Bhavānīśaṅkara statue and a land grant
historical_events.event_description: The inscription from 1716 CE records its renovation and establishment of a Bhavānīśaṅkara statue by Vaṃśīdharadeva Śarmā and his wife Lāvatī Brāhmaṇī, the descendants of its founder Jayasiṃhadeva. The Bhavānīśaṅkara statue mentioned in the inscription does not exist in or around the Phalcā at present. The inscription also records a land grant by them for celebrating the Phalcā’s anniversary rituals.

Puncali Phalcā was completely dismantled and reconstructed in 2003 CE (cf.Bāsukala & Gutschow2018). During the reconstruction, it was moved a few cubic feet back from its original location because it allegedly narrowed down the street too much.
Puncali Phalcā was severely damaged during the 2015 earthquakes.
After it was severely damaged during the 2015 earthquakes, Puncali Phalcā was reconstructed in 2019 CE with the financial support (of 23,58,759 rupees) from the Lalitpur Metropolitan City Office.
